description:
ROLE SUMMARY 
 Build and operate the production data pipelines that power the Innovation, Data & Analytics team's AI-based workflows, implementing the canonical data model and ensuring reliable, timely, high-quality data for downstream analytics and agentic systems. Own the integration layer that connects IDA's AI and agentic solutions to enterprise data sources and platforms, including governed data access, protection of personal information, and AI-ready data structures.

 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Data Integration, Pipeline Build & Production Ownership 
 Build and maintain data pipelines against the data model and standards defined by the Governance & Compliance team, and establish pipeline coding standards for solution-level integration work
 Own production reliability of the data platform (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), including monitoring and incident response
 Implement the canonical data model in production, including OMOP/HEDIS mappings where applicable
 Design and build data access patterns for agentic and LLM-based workflows, including retrieval pipelines and vector or graph-structured stores (e.g., RAG, GraphRAG)
 Integrate with enterprise data sources and Medical Affairs systems via APIs (e.g., REST/GraphQL, event-driven), prioritizing reuse across solutions
 
 Data Governance, Privacy & AI Readiness 
 Identify and classify personal information (PI/PII) flowing through pipelines, and apply masking, tokenization, or de-identification before data reaches AI-accessible stores
 Ensure data feeding agentic and LLM-based systems is well governed, accurately labeled, and monitored for quality and drift
 Maintain data dictionaries, lineage documentation, and playbooks aligned with enterprise data cataloging practices
 Ensure data integration practice complies with Pfizer data privacy and regulatory standards (HIPAA, GDPR, GxP as applicable)
 
 Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 
 Partner with the Senior Data Analyst to validate data model and mapping conformance
 Partner with the Senior Data Scientist and AI/ML Engineer to ensure pipelines meet the data needs of analytical models and agentic workflows
 Partner with the centralized AI Data Strategy teams and enterprise architecture to align on data sourcing, profiling, and reuse patterns
 Flag data quality issues and advise on required solutions
 Identify opportunities to improve pipeline performance, cost, and maintainability
 Document pipeline architecture and data flows to support governance and audit needs
 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 Candidate demonstrates strong technical execution and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, regulated environment, partnering effectively across data science, governance, and engineering functions.
 Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
 Experience (8+ years with Bachelor's; 7+ years with Master's) in data engineering, notably in the healthcare/pharma sector
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python
 Experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar)
 Experience designing and orchestrating ETL/ELT pipelines
 Experience with API design and integration patterns (e.g., REST/GraphQL, event-driven or streaming) for connecting applications to backend data sources
 Experience supporting RAG pipelines, vector databases, or other AI/ML data access patterns
 Experience identifying and protecting PI/PII in data pipelines, including masking, tokenization, or de-identification
 Solid understanding of Agile delivery and CI/CD practice
 Healthcare data experience (claims, EHR, HEDIS/OMOP) preferred
 Effective English verbal and written communication with flexibility to be clear, consistent, compliant, and appropriate for a variety of settings including scientific/technical, regulatory, and business audiences
 
 Technical: 
 Anticipates Customer and Market Needs – Knows the data landscape and downstream analytical needs; is dedicated to meeting the expectations of internal customers; always focused on patient safety first.
 Acts Decisively – Makes timely and effective engineering decisions; acts with urgency and removes barriers that hinder productivity.
 Builds Change-Agile Systems – Designs pipelines and data infrastructure that are flexible and adaptive to evolving business needs.
 Strategic and Innovative Thinking – Demonstrates insightful thinking by developing creative approaches to data engineering challenges.
 Is a role model of Pfizer's values and behaviors.
 
 Demonstrate ability to: 
 Drive transformational change
 Engage diverse technical and business stakeholders
 Understand the applications of technology to the Life Science sector
 
 Other Job Details:  
 Last Date to Apply for Job: September 23rd, 2026. 
 Locations: NYHQ or PA-Collegeville or MA-Cambridge or CT-Groton or Europe any Pfizer site or QC - Montreal
 NOT Eligible for Relocation Package 
 Position is hybrid and will require to work 2 to 3 days per week on site 
 
 #LI-PFE
  
  
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.  
  
  
  
  
  
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.
